triggers.name: guard_shopper_service_profiles
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_shopper_service_writes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_trusted_operation() then
    raise exception 'This record is managed through ParkVault service functions only'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end;
end $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_shopper_service_profiles BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON shopper_service_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_shopper_service_writes()

seller_storefronts:
SELECT sp.user_id,
    sp.slug,
    p.display_name,
    p.avatar_url,
    sp.bio,
    sp.created_at AS member_since,
    sp.stripe_details_submitted AND sp.stripe_payouts_enabled AS payout_verified,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM verified_sales vs
             JOIN orders o ON o.id = vs.order_id
          WHERE vs.is_live AND o.seller_id = sp.user_id) AS completed_sales_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM order_reviews r
          WHERE r.subject_id = sp.user_id) AS review_count,
    ( SELECT round(avg(r.rating), 2) AS round
           FROM order_reviews r
          WHERE r.subject_id = sp.user_id) AS rating_average,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM asks a
          WHERE a.seller_id = sp.user_id AND a.status = 'active'::listing_status AND a.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_at > now() AND NOT a.is_demo AND a.evidence_count > 0 AND a.public_media_count > 0) AS active_listing_count,
    sp.ship_from_city,
    sp.ship_from_region,
    sp.ship_from_country,
    sp.default_shipping_method,
    sp.default_handling_days
   FROM seller_profiles sp
     JOIN profiles p ON p.id = sp.user_id
  WHERE sp.status = 'active'::text;
is_trusted_operation:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_trusted_operation()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(current_setting('parkvault.trusted_operation', true) = 'on', false)
      -- Maintenance/administrative connections. These are NEVER treated as a
      -- marketplace member: member functions still require auth.uid().
      OR current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role');
$function$
